review_scope: Complete Chinese–English alignment read, title and deck included; first-five-essay midpoint completed. Existing complete English retained with thirteen localized corrections awaiting independent review.

changes.before: This is not stylistic symmetry. "Cannot not" performs a specific structural function — it strips the subject of its sense of authority.
changes.after: This is not stylistic symmetry. "Cannot not" performs a specific structural function — it strips the subject of its sense of power.
changes.reason: 权力感 is the sense of power, not legitimate authority.

changes.before: External condition: routes through negotiation and maneuver are exhausted. Contests of judgment, bargaining over interests, diplomacy, third-party mediation, the making and repairing of agreements — every non-violent route has been tried and has failed. Not abandoned after one or two attempts, but genuinely exhausted: under the existing structure there is no non-violent path left.
changes.after: External condition: routes through negotiation and maneuver are exhausted. Contests at the level of wisdom, bargaining over interests, diplomacy, third-party mediation, the making and repairing of agreements — every non-violent route has been tried and has failed. Not abandoned after one or two attempts, but genuinely exhausted: under the existing structure there is no non-violent path left.
changes.reason: Restore 智慧 and its explicit structural level.

changes.before: Internal condition: subjectivity has been forced to its limit. One's own position as a subject has reached the point where it will be lost without resistance — the carrier of cultivation itself is about to be eliminated. Note what this does not mean: not injured interests, not wounded standing, not possible future insecurity. It means that existence as a subject can no longer be structurally sustained.
changes.after: Internal condition: subjectivity has been forced to its limit. One's own position as a subject has reached the point where it will be lost without resistance — the carrier of cultivation itself is about to be eliminated. Note what this does not mean: not injured interests, not wounded pride, not possible future insecurity. It means that existence as a subject can no longer be structurally sustained.
changes.reason: 面子 is face or pride here, not the framework's subject standing.

changes.before: Neither condition suffices alone. Meet only the first, and cultivation can still continue by other means — endurance, concession, trading space for time. Meet only the second, and there are still non-war routes untried.
changes.after: Neither condition suffices alone. Meet only the first, and cultivation can still continue by other means — endurance, concession, trading time for space. Meet only the second, and there are still non-war routes untried.
changes.reason: The existing translation reverses the source 时间换空间. Preserve the author's actual direction without silently normalizing it.

changes.before: But "stakes" must be defined precisely. Not expansionist interest — territory, resources, markets — but the intervening party's own cultivation already being caught up in the situation. And a harder limit applies: that involvement must be structural erosion happening right now, not a probable future risk derived from a forecast.
changes.after: But "stakes" must be defined precisely. Not expansionist interest — territory, resources, markets — but the intervening party's own cultivation already being caught up in the situation. And a harder limit applies: that involvement must be structural erosion happening right now, not a future risk inferred from a forecast.
changes.reason: Do not add a probability assessment absent from the source.

changes.before: This boundary matters enormously, because "future risk" is the seedbed of every preventive-war rhetoric: they will threaten us eventually; if we do not act, we will be affected too; once they are strong it will be too late. That rhetoric can package any expansion as defense.
changes.after: This boundary matters enormously, because "future risk" is the seedbed of every preventive-war rhetoric: they will threaten us eventually; if we do not fight them, we will be affected too; once they are strong it will be too late. That rhetoric can package any expansion as defense.
changes.reason: Restore the explicit fighting in the quoted preventive-war rhetoric.

changes.before: The Napoleonic wars are the long case study in objective drift. The starting point was structurally defensible: a young republic facing coordinated intervention by several dynasties is a real defensive situation. But across the following fifteen years the objective slid steadily outward — from repelling intervention, to installing sister republics in neighboring states, to redrawing the map of Europe, to distributing relatives as kings, and finally to marching into a great power in 1812 to force compliance with a trade blockade.
changes.after: The Napoleonic wars are the long case study in objective drift. The starting point was structurally defensible: a young republic facing coordinated intervention by several dynasties is a real defensive situation. But over the following decade and more the objective slid steadily outward — from repelling intervention, to installing sister republics in neighboring states, to redrawing the map of Europe, to distributing relatives as kings, and finally to marching into a great power in 1812 to force compliance with a trade blockade.
changes.reason: Restore 十几年 rather than introducing the exact number fifteen.

changes.before: A war that began as defense spent fifteen years, without a single expansion test ever being applied, becoming the thing it had originally opposed.
changes.after: A war that began as defense spent more than a decade, without a single expansion test ever being applied, becoming the thing it had originally opposed.
changes.reason: Restore 十几年 rather than introducing the exact number fifteen.

changes.before: This definition anchors the end of a war outside the war, rather than in any internal state of winning or losing. That anchoring is the whole theorem.
changes.after: This definition anchors the end of a war outside the war, rather than in any internal state of winning or losing. That anchoring is the key to the whole theorem.
changes.reason: A key to the theorem is not identical to the whole theorem.

changes.before: Any means that forecloses the possibility of that ending in advance, or that structurally makes the other side's post-war cultivation impossible, is inadequate in principle.
changes.after: Constraint on means: any means that forecloses the possibility of that ending in advance, or that structurally makes the other side's post-war cultivation impossible, is inadequate in principle.
changes.reason: Restore the explicitly named 手段约束 label.

changes.before: Which means? Large-scale indiscriminate destruction, where it removes at a stroke the basis on which the other side could recover as a carrier of cultivation. Precision strikes aimed at the capacity for reconstitution — eliminating a cultural core, an educational core, a spiritual core in one blow. Even where casualty figures look modest, if the effect is that the other side cannot reorganize as a carrier of cultivation, the constraint is violated. And irreversible structural alteration — rendering a place uninhabitable long-term, destroying what cannot be rebuilt.
changes.after: Which means? Large-scale indiscriminate killing and injury, where it removes at a stroke the basis on which the other side could recover as a carrier of cultivation. Precision strikes aimed at the capacity for reconstitution — eliminating a cultural core, an educational core, a spiritual core in one blow. Even where casualty figures look modest, if the effect is that the other side cannot reorganize as a carrier of cultivation, the constraint is violated. And irreversible structural alteration — rendering a place uninhabitable long-term, destroying heritage that cannot be rebuilt.
changes.reason: Restore both lethal harm and the specific object heritage; generic destruction loses these distinctions.

changes.before: In the short run, a warring party can manufacture the appearance of passing Theorem Four through information control, performative mechanisms, and quiet persecution of questioners. But genuine openness to questioning is an expression of a society's subjective health, and subjective health shows up directly, over long stretches, in the rate of development. A society that permits no real questioning has its internal subjects systematically suppressed; they contribute no genuine creativity or judgment; and its development rate necessarily falls behind — with the gap compounding across decades and generations.
changes.after: In the short run, a warring party can manufacture the appearance of passing Theorem Four through information control, performative mechanisms, and quiet persecution of questioners. But genuine openness to questioning is an expression of the health of a society's subjectivity, and that health shows up directly, over long stretches, in the rate of development. A society that permits no real questioning has its internal subjects systematically suppressed; they contribute no genuine creativity or judgment; and its development rate necessarily falls behind — with the gap accumulating exponentially across decades and generations.
changes.reason: 主体性健康 concerns subjectivity, not a subjective impression of health; preserve the explicit exponential claim without endorsing it.

changes.before: Which means that assessing a war rarely requires a complete judgment on all four. And Theorem Four, as the externally observable diagnostic, is especially useful — look at it, and you can usually infer the approximate state of the other three.
changes.after: Which means that assessing whether a war meets the criteria usually does not require a complete judgment on all four. And Theorem Four, as the externally observable diagnostic, is especially useful — look at it, and you can usually infer the approximate state of the other three.
changes.reason: Restore the source qualifier 通常不需要, which is weaker than rarely requires.

unresolved_source_questions.finding: The example groups French Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars under one label and calls the initial situation purely defensive. Retain pending author review rather than silently rewrite the historical premise.

The example treats a decision whose scale changed in response to questioning as failure of an earlier test worded as having no weight in decisions. This is an authorial criterion question, not a translation omission.
